L3 (edge stress).why: cosmic-share accounting: baryons supply 0.186 of P_c (short by 5.4, not the lead's ~6.4 = 1/f_b, which is Omega_c/Omega_b + 1 for the TOTAL matter). Under the frozen line (mean AND isothermal <= 0.25 up to 1e13) it is NOT met: the mean-density ratio 3 g/a0 reaches 0.29 at 1e+13. Baryons alone cannot hold the edge; the stress must be carried by the cold infall (ram pressure) or by a mediator.

L4 (mediator).why: frozen line literal = NOT met at 1e13-1e14; holds for 1e10-1e12. alpha_req = 546 (1e10), 118 (1e12), 55 (1e13), 25 (1e14): 1e5-1e7 over the Cassini scale of a universal scalar; the mediator's own force on baryons is a0/2 = 17-4 g_law: it overshoots the law it must reproduce. A screened or non-universal mediator is not excluded here (untested).

L5 (wall-balance exponent).why: window 1.14 decades vs the 4 needed; the edge r_e ~ M^(1/2..1) outruns r_ta ~ M^(1/3)
